The strongest dense model that still fits a 32 GB machine. Quantisation-aware trained, so 4-bit costs almost nothing in quality here.
26B-class answers with under 4B active per token. The best quality-per-second on a strong laptop.
Reads text, images and audio. Comfortable on a laptop or a 16 GB phone.
The strongest sub-10B model measured anywhere, and the best of these at reading documents and photographs.

The one to have if your phone can hold it. Reads photographs of documents and receipts, handles Arabic and English, and a fifth bit of precision over the smaller build is a real quality difference you can feel on long answers.
Text, images and audio on a flagship phone. Pick this over the Qwen if you want voice notes read back to you.
The sweet spot on an ordinary modern phone. Everything the app does, in under 3 GB.
The same 4B model squeezed 10% smaller for a 4 GB phone. Slightly slower on older chips, and worth it to get the 4B rather than dropping to the 2B.
Runs on a cheap phone and still reads photographs. Short answers are good; long reasoning is where you'll notice the size.
For a phone that can't hold anything else. Useful for tidying and shortening text; don't ask it to reason.

Everything here runs on your own hardware, and the smallest useful model wants about 2 GB of memory to itself. Attune's tools that don't need a model still work.
